```yaml
name: Security Scan

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # daily

jobs:
  security:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: security-scan-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version: [1.20, 1.21]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go ${{ matrix.go-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}
          cache: true

      - name: Get CPU cores
        id: cpu
        uses: SimenB/github-actions-cpu-cores@v2

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Run tests
        run: go test ./... -v -race -count=1 -coverprofile=coverage.out
        env:
          GOMAXPROCS: ${{ steps.cpu.outputs.count }}

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v6
        with:
          version: v1.55
          args: --timeout=5m

      - name: Run gosec
        uses: securego/gosec@v2.21.0
        with:
          args: -exclude-dir=vendor -fmt=github -out=gosec-results.json ./...

      - name: Upload test coverage
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-${{ matrix.go-version }}
          path: coverage.out

      - name: Upload gosec results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: gosec-results-${{ matrix.go-version }}
          path: gosec-results.json

      - name: Teardown
        if: always()
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/teardown-linux@main
        with:
          skip-wait-ssh: true
```
